semantics.ambiguous_bases: N, R, Y, S, W, K, M, B, D, H, V: never GC and never valid; removed from the denominator by gc_fraction(remove_ambiguous = true)
semantics.base_encoding: genome.bv: 1 = unambiguous G/C; valid.bv: 1 = unambiguous A/C/G/T
semantics.remove_ambiguous: when true the denominator is valid.bv (A+C+G+T), otherwise the window length
semantics.uracil: U is the RNA spelling of T and is folded onto T: valid, never GC
semantics.window: half-open [start, end), 0-based, over the concatenated contigs
